spans.s:
मिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, become fat, fat; unctuous;
affectionately disposed towards any one.

. fr.
rt. 1. मी above), a fish [cf. नड-म्˚]; the sign of
[]
the zodiac, Pisces; N. of a teacher of the Yoga
system, = मीन-नाथ; (आ), f., N. of a daughter of
Uṣā and wife of Kaśyapa.
—मीन-केतन, अस्, m.
‘fish-bannered,’ an epithet of the god of love.
—मीन-गन्धा. f. an epithet of Satya-vatī; [cf.
मत्स्य-गन्धा.]
—मीन-गोधिका, f. a pool, pond.
—मीन-घातिन्, ई, m. ‘fish-killer,’ a fisherman; a
crane.
—मीन-ता, f. the state or condition of a fish.
—मीन-धावन-तोय, अम्, n. water in which fish
have been washed.
—मीन-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of a
teacher of the Yoga system.
—मीन-नेत्रा, f. a
species of Dūrvā grass (= गण्ड-दूर्वा; cf. नेत्र-
मीना).
—मीन-रङ्क or मीन-रङ्ग, अस्, m. a
kingfisher.
—मीन-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—मीन-राज, अस्, m. the king of the fishes; N. of
an astrologer.
—मीनराज-जातक, अम्, n., N. of
an astrological work by Yavaneśvara.
—मीन-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, possessing fish, abounding in fish.
—मी-
नाक्ष (˚न-अक्˚), अस्, m. ‘fish-eyed,’ N. of a
Rākṣasa; (ई), f. a species of Soma plant, a kind of
Dūrvā grass [cf. मत्स्याक्षी]; N. of a daughter of
Kuvera.
—मीनाघातिन् (˚न-आघ्˚), ई, m. = मीन-
घातिन्, q. v.
—मीनाण्ड (˚न-अण्˚), अम्, n. fish-
spawn, roe, milt; (ई), f. moist or brown sugar.
—मीनालय (˚न-आल्˚), अस्, m. ‘abode of fish,’ the
sea, ocean.

मिन्दा मिन्दा, f., Ved. a bodily defect,
fault, blemish; [cf. Lat. menda.]

मिन्व् मिन्व् (connected with rts. निन्व्,
सिन्व्), cl. 1. P. मिन्वति, &c., to
sprinkle, moisten, water (= rt. पिन्व्); to worship,
serve, gratify by service.
मीनर, अस्, m. a kind of sea-monster (= मकर).

मीनाम्रीण, अस्, m. = दर्दुराम्र, a kind of
sauce or condiment, fish-sauce; a wag-tail.
